summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing FDA approval of Saphnelo Pen (anifrolumab) for subcutaneous self-administration in systemic lupus erythematosus. The filing includes regulatory updates, trial results, and executive commentary, but no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer. It is a routine product approval disclosure by a foreign issuer under Rule 13a-16.
